newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BARCO LIKELY TO ENTER BEL-20 - BOURSE.
newsitem.headline: BARCO LIKELY TO ENTER BEL-20 - BOURSE.

text.p: Belgian electronics company Barco is likely to enter the Brussels Bel-20 share index in December when the composition of the index comes up for its regular review, the Brussels Stock Exchange said on Wednesday.

"It is probable, even sure, that Barco is going to get in. On the basis of the statistics we have to now, it will be either Cockerill or CMB which will come out, but obviously we have to wait and see," deputy chairman of the bourse Anne Vleminckx told Reuters.
"At the moment it is most likely that it will be Cockerill (which falls out)," she added.
The bourse reviews the composition of the Bel-20 each year, looking at trading volumes of Belgian stocks over the previous 12 months.
Incoming stocks must have been among the top-20 most heavily traded issues in eight months of the year. Outgoing stocks must have been outside the top-20 for at least seven months.

Vleminckx said the bourse would make its judgement sometime at the beginning of December, while the change in the composition of the index would come into force after the third Friday in December -- the expiry date for December options and futures.
"We are going to announce (the result of the review) sufficiently in advance so that the market has time to anticipate the change," Vleminckx said.
